I'd have given anything to have seen the Profundity! It used to be a Mon Calamari city tower, you know, before it was converted to a warship!|[[Sprocket]]|{{HuntersCite|character=Sprocket|costume=Mon Cala Profundity}}}} The '''''Profundity''''' was an [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] commanded by [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] that served in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]]. It was notably present during the [[Battle of Scarif]]. Shortly after the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Death Star plans|plans]] were transmitted to Raddus, the [[Starship|vessel]] was incapacitated by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'' and boarded by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in an attempt to reclaim the stolen [[Data-tape|data tapes]]. As the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Dark Lord]] stormed the corridors of the starship, a small group of [[Rebel trooper]]s were able to evacuate on board the ''[[Tantive IV]]'', which had been docked with the ''Profundity'', relinquishing the plans to [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. ==History== {{Quote|The Rebel flagship is disabled, my lord, but has received transmissions from the surface.''"''
''"''Prepare a boarding party.''"''
''"''Yes, my lord.|Shaef Corssin and Darth Vader|}} [[File:ProfoundityBridge-RogueOne5.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Raddus and a rebel trooper on the bridge of the ''Profundity'' discussing Rogue One]] Originally, the ''Profundity'' was the civic governance tower of the [[city]] of [[Nystullum]]. Like many [[Mon Calamari]] buildings, the tower was converted into a [[Starship|ship]] and was part of the [[Mon Calamari Exodus Fleet|exodus fleet]] that departed from the Mon Calamari [[Mon Cala|homeworld]] under command of [[Raddus]], the city's [[mayor]]. Many of the ships crew members were former defense staff for the city of Nystullum. When the Mon Calamari joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Alliance]], the ''Profundity'' was one of the first ships to be converted into a [[warship]]. When [[Rogue One]]'s departure for [[Scarif]] became known, [[Admiral]] Raddus gathered as many ships as he could to support them. After the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] arrived at Scarif, the ''Profundity'' took part in the [[Battle of Scarif|battle]], acting as the command ship for the Alliance's forces. As the battle concluded, the ''Profundity'' intercepted the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Death Star plans|plans]] beamed to the ship by [[Jyn Erso]] of Rogue One. Before the cruiser could depart with the prize, it was incapacitated by the ''[[Devastator]]'' and boarded by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in an attempt to recover the plans. [[File:VadersBoardingPartyProfundity-R1.png|thumb|left|280px|Vader and his forces prepare to board the damaged ''Profundity'']] A few [[Rebel trooper]]s from the ''[[Tantive IV]]'' managed to download the plans to a [[Data-tape|data tape]] and attempted to make their escape to the ship in the ''Profundity''{{'s}} docking bay. Just as the Rebels reached the door, however, a mechanical failure caused by damage jammed it. A few moments after the door jammed, Vader arrived in the hallway. The rebels held Vader off for as long as they could until [[Unidentified fleet trooper|one trooper]] was able to pass the plans through the gap in the door to [[Toshma Jefkin|their fellow]] crew on the ship. The [[corvette]] quickly launched from the vessel, leaving Vader standing in the bay. By the end of the engagement, the ''Profundity'' was destroyed. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Profundity'' first appeared in ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' directed by [[Gareth Edwards]] and was first named in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. In early concept art, it was referred to as the "Rebel trawler."''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' An adventure and encounter seed in ''[[Starships and Speeders]]'', a [[2020]] sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series by [[Fantasy Flight Games]], stated that the ''Profundity'' was found intact, and that the Empire sought to use it as a target in a weapon testing range.''[[Starships and Speeders]]'' ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Profundity}} *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] {{Ab|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[Rogue One Adaptation 5|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 5]] *[[Rogue One Adaptation 6|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 6]] *{{GOA|Darth Vader -
